svg.font-family: Segoe Print, Comic Sans MS, Chalkboard SE, sans-serif

text.tspan: Example app only: it shows which D3SCOPE pieces a finance app would use. D3SCOPE builds the charts + structure, not the app.
All three v1 directions kept as sub-views (sidebar, like Portfolio Performance). Default view = Overview (v1-A). Locale fr-FR, light theme.
The app itself - NOT D3SCOPE (nav, KPIs, tables)
KPI cards [app - computed by the app, not D3SCOPE]
D3SCOPE scope for this example: core = area/line + time scale, donut/pie + legend, sparkline, tooltip/crosshair,
chart.update(data), locale-aware formatting (fr-FR default, configurable), light theme tokens (dark in v2).
Core plugins = treemap, brush. Finance plugin (separate repo) = candlestick + finance helpers.
Everything grey (navigation, KPIs, tables, settings UI) belongs to the app, not to the library.
